pages.title: Room-Temperature Superconductivity
pages.text: $(thing)Room-Temperature Superconductivity$()$(br2)Cooper pairs that hold together at room temperature, inside a hydrogen-rich framework.

$(thing)Insight$(): 110$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Supramolecular Chemistry, Mass Manipulation.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Metal-Organic Framework.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Electrons near the Fermi surface attract each other through lattice vibrations, but only within the Debye energy ħωD of it, with dimensionless coupling λ. At the critical temperature the pairing gap just vanishes, and the self-consistency condition reduces to an integral over the electron energy ξ weighted by the thermal occupation factor. Write that condition.
